title: Low-GI Chili con Carne with Two-Bean Base
description: Omitting white rice and utilizing a two-bean foundation provides 10.5g of dietary fiber. The high proportion of resistant starch creates a low glycemic excursion and fuels colonic SCFA production.
diabeticNotes: Black beans and red kidney beans deliver resistant starch and fermentable fiber that promote colonic propionate production, enhancing whole-body insulin sensitivity on subsequent meals.

ingredients.name: canned black beans, rinsed and drained
canned red kidney beans, rinsed and drained

steps.title: Sauté Aromatics
steps.description: Heat olive oil in a heavy pot over medium heat. Sauté diced yellow onion and minced garlic until translucent.

steps.title: Brown Lean Beef
steps.description: Add extra-lean ground beef to the pot, breaking up with a spoon until thoroughly browned.

steps.title: Add Beans & Tomatoes
steps.description: Stir in rinsed black beans, red kidney beans, and crushed canned tomatoes.

steps.title: Simmer Chili
steps.description: Reduce heat to low, cover pot, and simmer gently for 25 minutes to develop rich, complex flavors.

steps.title: Rest & Serve
steps.description: Uncover and let chili rest for 2 minutes off heat. Ladle into a bowl and serve hot.
